editorial.blurb: Replay Andersonville is a welcoming neighborhood spot where excellent brunch meets laid-back hospitality and free arcade games.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for brunch on a Saturday morning—order the Chicken and Waffles, grab a champagne cocktail, and snag a table by the window for people-watching; the staff remembers regulars and the vibe is upscale-casual with free arcade games.
signatureDishes: Green eggs and ham with pesto eggs
